notes.title: Sincere Apology!
notes.content:
[h2][b]全世界的玩家们，你们好！！[/b][/h2]

也许你已经注意到了我在X上关于通过Steam上的负面评论请求本土化的Tweet。

为了支持所有玩家，我不断更新游戏及其本地化内容，尽管游戏仍然没有盈利。
遗憾的是，我还没有幸运地找到理想的中文翻译-中文本地化过程是具有挑战性的，我想为您提供完美的工作。我不想使用廉价的AI/谷歌翻译。

这就是为什么我在X上表达了我关于留下差评要求新的本土化的感受。从财务角度来看，这些审查会使整个过程对我来说更具挑战性。

除此之外，我还发表了一些可能会冒犯你的评论。这不是故意的，我真的很抱歉！！！！！

我仍然会尝试更新游戏并添加新的本地化内容，包括简体中文，但作为一名独立开发者，我的行动相当缓慢。所以请原谅我。

再给我一次机会，对我有耐心。我的个人目标是通过游戏传播乐趣，而不是冲突。

你的真诚,

Karel又名KO。DLL


[b][h2][h1]Hello, dear players across the whole world, no matter where you live!!![/h1][/h2][/b]

Maybe you have registered my Tweet on X about requesting localizations through negative reviews here on Steam.

I continuously update the game and its localizations to support all players, even though the game is still not profitable.
Sadly, I have not yet been lucky enough to find the ideal Chinese translator - the Chinese localization process is challenging, and I want to deliver perfect work to you. I don't want to use a cheap AI/Google translation.

That's why I expressed my feelings on X about leaving negative reviews asking for new localization. These reviews can make the whole process even more challenging for me - from a financial perspective.

Together with that, I made some comments which could offend you. It was not intentional,
and [b]I am genuinely sorry about that!!!!![/b]

I will still try to update the game and add new localizations, including Simplified Chinese, but as a solo developer, I am pretty slow. So please, excuse me for that.

Give me another chance, and be patient with me. 

My personal goal is to spread fun through my games, not conflicts.

Yours sincerely,

Karel aka KO.DLL

PS:
I understand that I made a few extremely foolish jokes (at least, I thought these jokes were just naive and unharming), and I did not realize I was brutally offending somebody. I am not skilled in political situations, and my social skills and English are limited - which is not an excuse!!!
But I am realizing my mistakes now. So, I am genuinely sorry. I honestly did not want to offend somebody. Maybe I am naive and stupid, but I am not racist.

notes.title: Winter Holidays 2024 Update v1.327.
notes.content:
[b][h2]Happy Winter Holidays! [/h2][/b]

The new year is just around the corner, and BZZZT has been with us for exactly one year and one month. During that time, I released 12 updates and 3 major ones.

This update, the last 2024 one, focuses on community feedback, suggestions, and bug reports.

[b]Here is the complete list of changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] The "Quick Restart" option has been added to the "Game Over" screen in Insane Mode.
[*] The game (together with music and sounds) is paused while the game is suspended (minimized or without focus).
[*] "Ambush" stage (no. 10) - The first secret room camera interpolation can't be interrupted by the enemies' entry cutscene.
[*] "Why Is That Laser Chasing Me?" stage (no. 23) - Camera movement is no longer blocking the player on the top of the screen in very easy mode.
[*] "Jump, Run, Dash and Fall" stage (no. 34) - The level has been changed slightly in Very Easy Mode.
[*] "Exploding Lemmings" stage (no. 35) -  Moving Platform has been fixed, and the player can jump from it while it's moving.
[*] Tiny tweaks and fixes.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545167/0594a6a82b974c5a47e3b2fc04b33edf140f4346.png[/img]

[b][h2]YEAR 2024 IN A NUTSHELL[/h2][/b]

The game was nominated for many indie game events during this year and was awarded in the following categories:
[list]
[*] Czech Game of the Year 2023 - 4 categories:
[list]
[*] Best Audio/Visual - 1st place.
[*] Best Game of the Year - 2nd place.
[*] Best Game Design - 3rd place.
[*] Community Vote - 3rd place.
[/list]
[*] AMD PIXEL AWARDS EUROPE 2024 - Best Soundtrack - 1st place.
[*] Indian-TV - Community Vote 2023 - Indie Game of the Year - 1st place.
[*] INDIE DB - Community Vote - Indie Game of the Year - 6th place.
[/list]

Together with 98% overwhelmingly positive reviews from players, the BZZZT is ranked as the 109th best-rated Steam game released in 2023.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545167/901abacc158157158ff07f0121cd0f937fb20932.jpg[/img]

Thank you very, very much for being so supportive. Without you, I would not have achieved such tremendous success.

You are the best!!!

I wish you a happy new year 2025!!!

Karel, aka KO.DLL

notes.title: "Very Easy" mode is live!
notes.content:
[b][h3]Hello everyone![/h3][/b]
I am happy to announce the new content update for my BZZZT game,
which is mostly dedicated to the VERY EASY mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545167/27a3e056492e006c9f2c9529dd8609555d76803e.png[/img]

This game mode was carefully designed for kids, their parents, and anyone wanting to enjoy the BZZZT game without intense challenges.

You can now train your platformer skills at newly redesigned levels with fewer traps, enemies, and other hazards while still being able to collect trophies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545167/15da5be025fcc1b0dc2fa131b9e60e3969b36847.gif[/img]

[b][h3]Together with that, I have implemented the following changes:[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] Tweaked difficulty in a few of the most challenging levels.
[*] The game is now more optimized (code, physics, graphics assets), and it should run better at higher framerates (+160Hz)
[*] Minor fixes.
[*] Added the SAVEGAME backup system. The game now stores the BzzztSave.bak file in the AppData folder.
[/list]

Have a great day, and please let me know your thoughts on this update.

[h3]Thank you![/h3]

Karel, aka KO.DLL



[h3]Note:[/h3]
Please do not experiment with modifying SAVEGAME files.
It serves only for backing-up purposes (cloud error, migrating the game to another computer with disabled Steam Cloud, etc.)

Windows, Mac, and Linux have the following locations of SAVEGAME backup files (BzzztSave.bak):
[list]
[*] Windows: %userprofile%\AppData\LocalLow\Kodll\Bzzzt\BzzztSave.bak
[*] Linux: $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/unity3d or $HOME/.config/unity3d.
[*] Mac: ~/Library/Application Support/Kodll/Bzzzt
[/list]

The original SAVEGAME (BzzztSave.sav) location for the Steam version is still the same (in the install directory under the "Bzzzt_Data" subfolder.

notes.title: 1.006 Update is live!
notes.content:
Hello!
The most complex change I had to make was to optimize the game and FPS drops reported by players. It took some time, but I hope it is way better now - together with testers, we did not observe any performance drops.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545167/769c9dd4b3e3b93cd30faa040933c0b92d5b7a90.gif[/img]

[h2]Here is the complete list of all improvements and tweaks:[/h2]
[h3]System improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] The [b]"Camera Shake"[/b] toggle is added to the settings now.

[*] Players can press the confirm/jump button while the teleporting animation is played to skip the reward screen animation and quickly enter the next stage.

[*] Improved preloading system to eliminate FPS drops during the gameplay.

[*] There are optimized shaders and particles for a smoother experience on weaker computers - it should grant at least two times better performance in all stages.

[*] The music track is not interrupted when changed during the cutscene after the stage restart.

[*] Improved firing turrets system. The projectiles detect collisions with enemies more precisely.
[/list]

[h3]Difficulty tweaks:[/h3]
[list]
[*] The section with the double dash over the laser field in the [b]"Dashing Machine"[/b] stage (no. 16) is now less challenging.

[*] The laser beam in the [b]"Why Is That Laser Chasing Me?"[/b] stage (no. 23) is slower on easy difficulty now.

[*] The [b]"System Overheat"[/b] stage (no. 9) has simplified the last area before teleport. Circular saws are moved off a bit.

[*] Rockets flying towards the player in [b]"Flight To The Island"[/b] Level (no. 26) are slower now.
[/list]

Together with that, I would love to thank you for your fantastic support. The Bzzzt game has reached 37k wishlists and still has a breathtaking 99% positive reviews here on Steam.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545167/9d7982baaa3599f6c4ad7166f491fceee36f13cb.gif[/img]

Have a great rest of the weekend!

Karel Matejka aka KO.DLL

notes.title: Dev Log 4/23
notes.content:
Hello gamers,
First, thank you very much for your support during and after the NEXT FEST! It was breathtaking!

Today, I would love to share some info about BZZZT development. There has been a lot coming in the last two months.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545167/01ed18343b808926a3ac972f8fadb151811dfb71.gif[/img]

All special abilities are implemented. There are 5 of them - one for each world. It means a player can unlock them continuously by using upgrading machines.

Together with that, I had to expand the number of levels from 50 to 60. I did it because ten levels per world did not allow me to introduce new gameplay features and traps fluently enough. So, right now, the learning curve should be less aggressive.

[previewyoutube=Z6c2OnZQUwE;full][/previewyoutube]

I have changed the native resolution of the game. Players can see more of the environment around them now. It allows them to react to deadly traps in advance, and previously unexpected traps and enemies hidden behind the edge of the screen are now fairer.

I have increased the main character's walking speed by 10% - the game is now more dynamic.

I am starting to implement cutscenes and other story animations. It can be seen in this video:

[previewyoutube=HgBrK03qjOw;full][/previewyoutube]

Ane even more - Luckily, I saved some time and added some environmental animations to the game. They are not essential, but I feel the game environment can be more living with that.

[url=https://youtube.com/shorts/SD8tC6rGYD8]Grass & Butterflies interaction (YOUTUBE Short).[/url]

I am also doing some playtests and tweaking current levels based on players' feedback. It is enjoyable to observe other players playing my game.

That's all so far.

Thanks a lot for your great support and feedback on social media pages!
Karel Matejka, aka KO.DLL

notes.title: Dev Log 2/23
notes.content:
Maybe you already know that, but the BZZZT game is being developed by one humble artist (me) and one excellent music composer, Martin Linda.

With this project, I wanted to pay tribute to all the much-loved games from the '80s, which I grew on, and they were the main reason I started making games.

So, one day I said to myself: "Wouldn't it be cool to time travel back to the golden era of arcade games and enjoy it again?"

And that day, my indie journey started! It was the beginning of BZZZT development!!!

And because there isn't an army of community managers behind me, I am sharing my solo-dev progress across social media alone. You can find me & my pixel art together with the Bzzzt development on the following platforms:

notes.title: Dev Log 7/22
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545167/68f51cd80d428f991aa4b69dc30e4f6cf4c24848.png[/img]

A lot of people asked me to share with them some info about the Bzzzt game and I was trying to be as mysterious as possible - it was caused mainly because I did not want to ruin players' first impressions from playing the full game - after the release 🙂

[b]But maybe I can uncover a few, not story-related details. So I have decided to write down a short summary of what I feel the Bzzzt game is about:[/b]

The game is highly inspired by the late '80s when I started to make games. But I did not want to make it super retro - I just want to create something that will reflect that era and how we remember it nowadays (with rainbow glasses) 🙂

Maybe the game will be shorter - only 50 levels - but I want to have it really polished - from precise controls to great-looking art and animations. And shorter means I am trying to make it accessible to not skilled players as well as for players who love games like Super Meat Boy or Celeste - for them, there are prepared some more challenging modes and records to achieve - I feel, with that the game has really strong replayability value. So it is possible to finish the game in 3 hours, but to collect all the trophies players will need to invest much more time into that.

The game is not about killing enemies. It means the player has no weapons. Your main goal is "just" to reach an exit in every room while jumping over the traps and enemies.

I know that only jumping does not stand too long to be fun so I have added there 5 special abilities on top of that - double jump, dash, sliding on magnetic walls, swimming and transferring a robotic body into an energy form. I will be sharing videos illustrating all game features soon.

As I said at the beginning I would not talk about the story for now because I feel it is really strong and I don't want to make some unnecessary spoilers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545167/89f34a1c230b2716e55c74d8938bfde1c2f62983.gif[/img]

notes.title: Bzzzt DEMO
notes.content:
[h1]Download demo for free.[/h1]
[h2]TRY NOT TO DIE[/h2]

[b]How long is Bzzzt demo?[/b]
Demo contains 10 levels. You can finish it in approximately 30 minutes.

[b]Is there a multiplayer mode?[/b]
No, the demo can be played only in a single-player mode.

[b]What platforms are supported?[/b]
At this moment we are developing this game for PC and Mac. But we are planning to release Bzzzt on Nintendo Switch and Xbox One as well.

[b]Approximately how long will this game be in development?[/b]
The release is planned for Spring 2021.

[b]Do I need a gamepad to play this game?[/b]
The game is fully optimized for keyboard and most common gamepads but we strongly recommend playing this game with a gamepad.

[b]Is this game just about jumping?[/b]
Demoversion contains only a fragment of gameplay mechanics. There is much more you will be able to do inside the game!

[b]I ♥ Pixel art![/b]
We decided to bring back to players the original 80's games experience and together with that we just decided to make this game a retro as much as possible but still with modern technologies support. No matter how your graphics card and monitor are set, this game will be always sharp and pixel perfect! 80's were 2d!
